Hi Jill —

Thanks for sending the forms over. Quick confirmations below so our payments team has the right PO mapping and remittance flow:

- PO reference: Please reference "PO 67821 / Pilot" in the invoice header and include the PO number in the electronic invoice reference field. That ensures the PO is auto-attached to payments in our ERP.
- Remittance string: For ACH please put the invoice number and PO (e.g., INV-2028-0123 | PO-67821) in the ACH payment description. For wires, include the same PO+invoice text in the wire reference/tag.
- Bank enrollment: We require a single micro-deposit confirmation for ACH verification. If you prefer wire for the first payment, please confirm and we'll mark it as one-off.

I've attached the draft PO for signatures and looped in Marissa (Payments) and Priyom (Procurement) to validate routing formatting. Marissa — can you confirm if our payments system requires any additional remittance code for VenuoTech?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

Hi all,

Quick note from Payments ops: ACH micro-deposit is preferred — it establishes the routing proof we need for recurring payments. Micro-deposit will appear as two small amounts in your bank account (0.10 and 0.32 USD typical). Once you confirm the amounts we set the vendor status to "Active" and schedule the payment.

If you need the first invoice paid by wire instead of waiting for micro-deposit clearance, we can process a one-time wire (same-day) but we charge a $25 wire fee for vendor-initiated first-time wires. If you want to proceed, reply with the exact wire memo to use and we'll push it through today.

Also attached is the signed copy of PO-67821 (PO-67821.pdf) with invoice terms net-30.

Marissa Cole
